title: Shim: Deterministic-First Command Router, Closed Slash Allowlist & Mutating Classification
summary: Shim routes natural-language slash intents in two strict stages via internal/router/router.go: Stage 1 (Deterministic) checks normalized multilingual readOnly and mutating keyword tables plus usePattern model selection regexes to resolve commands like /help, /status, /models, /skills, /tools, /mcps, /doctor, /discover --add, /session new, and /model use NAME at zero LLM cost. Stage 2 (Compile) invokes a bounded MaxTokens=300 LLM call only on deterministic miss, strips markdown fences, and passes output through Validate(), which tokenizes arguments via Split() and permits only a closed allowlist of slash commands with explicit Mutating classification.

references.description: Deterministic() zero-LLM lookup tables, usePattern regex, and Compile() MaxTokens=300 fallback
Validate() closed slash-command allowlist, Mutating classification, and Split() shell-style tokenizer

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Route common operator commands deterministically before spending model tokens, and gate any LLM-compiled command behind strict argument tokenization and a closed slash-command allowlist with mutating flags.
